claim_boundary: This is a prospective independent-replacement registration. It is not a v1/v2/v3/v4 retry and contains no v5 measurement, margin, coverage result, capacity certificate, selector result, or paper claim.
counting_rule: Only a complete v5 visit with nine passing functionals and nine passing scheduler interval audits contributes one v5 joint unit. No v1/v2/v3/v4 visit, partial v5 visit, failed attempt, or replacement visit counts.

no retry of a consumed or partial attempt

measurement_bundles.freeze_rule: Every calibration and holdout visit must use these same two registered current manifests. A code change invalidates the remaining split; it does not admit mixed versions.

predictor_compatibility_audit.basis: The August measurements are used only to freeze the deterministic empty and loaded point predictors. Split-conformal validity is provided by nineteen fresh exchangeable joint calibration visits and one independent holdout measured with one frozen current bundle.

findings.finding: The selected jtl110gpu2 workload/profile definitions, natural-completion estimands, and launch arguments are unchanged. Current changes add an injectable code-identity callback, strengthen the environment preflight, and add a jtl311linux-only profile override.

Current code rejects progress counters whose declared total differs from the registered total and ignores lower-ranked duplicate terminal bars. This can change readiness diagnostics and phase decomposition, but the aligned registered functional remains natural-exit drain time. The new calibration and holdout must therefore use one frozen current bundle; old calibration residuals cannot be reused.
Remote output retrieval now uses bounded chunks and verifies the reconstructed bytes. Workload commands and measured clocks are not changed.

The current LLM command exports the registered node PYTHONPATH. This is not an exact execution replica of the August empty campaign and may shift duration, but it keeps the same model, batch, sequence, precision, step count, checkpoint, and natural-exit drain estimand. Fresh current-bundle calibration absorbs this shift.

Relative to the August loaded bundle, the only changed shared source adds a CNN capacity override for jtl311linux. Neither selected jtl110gpu2 loaded scenario, its resident/target command, nor the target natural-completion functional changes.

predictor_provenance.source: same frozen August point predictors registered by v1

replacement_basis.reason: v1 stopped on external interval overlap; v2 stopped on its recorded scheduler-overlap incident; v3 stopped at wave 59 after undeclared host CPU work; v4 ended in FAIL_RESULT_STATE after its wave-85 controller was evicted before measurement

auto_adopted_child_rule.current_call: Exclude only an auto-adopted child with exact current-call run identity and verified command provenance.
auto_adopted_child_rule.prior_call: Exclude a prior-call child only when exact provenance and detached-wrapper/child-wait evidence prove process exit before the current measurement starts.

scheduler_interval_guard.failure_action: Fail-stop the complete v5 campaign, retain the affected attempt, and do not release the holdout or replace the visit.
scheduler_interval_guard.pass_condition: No unrelated or live target-node process overlaps a measurement interval; exclusions require exact child provenance and, for a prior call, proven exit before the current interval.

terminal_history_refresh.intervals: the original seven empty and two loaded measurement intervals
terminal_history_refresh.purpose: catch scheduler tasks recorded after an immediate per-call audit

score_contract.joint_wave_score: maximum cell_score over exactly nine registered functionals
score_contract.margin: max(0, nineteenth order statistic of 19 joint-wave scores)
